body:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGE: high-error-rate + latency spike on dedicated inference pools. Root suspects: KV-cache eviction storm compounded by quantized kernel memcpy/regression. Alert at 2026-06-11T02:15:00Z. Paging oncall.

Maya Chen: I'm online. Which pools are affected and any customer reports?

SRE-Bot: Alerts show sustained error_rate >8% across eu-west-1 and us-east-2 dedicated pools starting ~02:12. KV miss_rate elevated; memcpy latency high.

Liam O'Neill: pulling logs. Snippet:
```
2026-06-11T02:13:14Z [gen] kv_shard=3 miss_rate=0.69 evictions=3420 mem_pressure=81% model=v3.1-q4_4bit batch_size=40
2026-06-11T02:13:21Z [gen] memcpy_time=1420ms alloc_retries=5 kernel=quantized_packed_expand
```
Suspect: new packed-expand path added for 4bit quant that causes heavy copies under large batches.

Ana Rodriguez: did a deploy for v3.1 variants go out last night? I saw a release but thought it was gated.

Liam O'Neill: there was a late autopromote for canary due to a misconfig in release gating. Canary reached 30% on several dedicated pools.

Maya Chen: immediate mitigations: 1) cut canary weight to 0; 2) revert pools to v3.0-stable; 3) reduce batch_size to 12 on affected pools. Liam, can you run the rollback and config change? Priya, flag customers.

Liam O'Neill: executing:
- `redwoodctl rollout set --pool eu-west-1 --model v3.0-stable --weight 100` -> applied
- `redwoodctl config set --pool eu-west-1 batch_size=12` -> applied
- repeating for us-east-2

Deploy-bot: Rollout: model rollback triggered by Liam O'Neill at 2026-06-11T02:18:02Z. Canary weight -> 0. Config changes applied.

Priya Patel: CS: two enterprise customers reported truncated outputs and retry loops. Cases CS-8412 and CS-8417. Notifying them and offering immediate mitigations.

Maya Chen: Ana, take watch after rollback. I'll capture timeline and start a postmortem draft. Also create remediation cards.

Ana Rodriguez: picking up watch. Post-rollback metrics: p95 latency back to baseline in ~60s; error_rate dropping from 9% -> 1.5%; kv miss_rate down to ~0.08. Will keep 30m watch.

Liam O'Neill: quick repro notes (staging): v3.1-q4_4bit, batch_size sweep 8/12/16/24/40, prefix-heavy workload ~2500 concurrent short prompts. Observed memcpy spikes and LRU churn at batch_size >= 24. Minimal repro harness in infra/test-repro/kv-quant-harness.

Maya Chen: immediate actions to log into remediation board:
- R1: Isolate and fix packed-expand memcpy path in quant kernel (owner: Liam O'Neill, bug INF-3178)
- R2: Add CI perf test simulating heavy KV prefix reuse with quantized variants (owner: Eng Runtime)
- R3: Cap default batch_size for 4bit/packed quant variants to 16 in runtime (owner: Eng Runtime)
- R4: Emit shard-level KV metrics: miss_rate, evictions, memcpy_time, mem_pressure (owner: SRE)
- R5: Console: prevent autopromote for experimental variants and require perf smoke (owner: Product)
- R6: CS customer follow-ups and distribution for postmortem (owner: Priya Patel)

Priya Patel: will send initial customer note within the hour, add them to postmortem invite list, and offer an interim workaround (pause canary / reduce concurrency).

Tomas Krawczyk: Product will open Console change request to mark model variants as experimental and block autopromote. I'll attach the incident link.

Liam O'Neill: created INF-3178 and pushed initial repro and flamegraphs. Plan: change kernel to avoid full expand-copy when tokens are already accessible, add in-place path, and add allocator throttling. ETA: patch PR in 3 business days, perf validation 2 days after.

Eng Runtime Lead: agree on adding a health-check that fails canary if memcpy_time > 500ms for 30s. We'll add this to the release gating rules.

Maya Chen: postmortem meeting proposed: 2026-06-11 17:00 UTC, 45 minutes. Please confirm availability (Eng Runtime, SRE, Product, CS, Release Eng).

Ana Rodriguez: I can present timeline and metrics. Also will capture watch logs and anomaly graphs.

Priya Patel: I'll prepare customer impact summary and CS notes. Confirmed.

Liam O'Neill: adding follow-ups: add a hook to cap batch_size per model-variant and a runtime pre-flight check that refuses batch_size > cap for quantized variants. I'll attach config PR to INF-3178.

Maya Chen: set tentative due dates on board:
- INF-3178 kernel fix -> due 2026-06-18
- CI perf/regression test -> due 2026-06-16
- Batch cap runtime change -> due 2026-06-15
- Metrics emission -> due 2026-06-14
- Console autopromote guard -> due 2026-06-20

SRE-Bot: monitoring rule added: if per-pool memcpy_time > 0.5s for 2 consecutive minutes -> autotriggers canary cut to 0 and page oncall.

Maya Chen: action owners, please update the remediation board with exact owners and set realistic due dates. I'll publish the postmortem doc after the meeting.

Priya Patel: customer comms sent. I'll do a 24-hour update and then weekly until fix validated.

Liam O'Neill: prep note for postmortem: consider adding a regression smoke job in CI that runs quantized variants under KV-heavy workloads and checks memcpy latency and LRU churn. Also add a documentation note about safe batch-size limits per quant profile.

Ana Rodriguez: watching for regressions. If error_rate > 2% for 3 minutes we reopen paging.

IncidentBot: incident -> mitigated. Postmortem required. Please update remediation cards and link bugs/PRs.

Maya Chen: closing live-incident channel. We'll continue with remediation tracking and the postmortem trail in the incidents channel and the postmortems doc. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
